title: SAE SSV Optimization Scripts
summary: This module provides scripts for optimizing Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) Sparse Steering Vectors (SSV) and evaluating their performance in steering language models. It supports both optimization-only runs and full generation/judging workflows.

nodes.label: Main Optimization Workflow
nodes.title: Main Optimization Workflow
nodes.description: Orchestrates the entire SAE SSV optimization process, including argument parsing, configuration loading, latent collection, F-statistic computation, vector optimization, and result saving.

nodes.label: Run Steering Condition
nodes.title: Run Steering Condition
nodes.description: Executes a steering condition by generating text with a given steering vector and alpha, then judging the generated replies against a rubric.

nodes.label: Load Language Model
nodes.title: Load Language Model and Tokenizer
nodes.description: Loads the pre-trained language model and its corresponding tokenizer for text generation and latent collection.

nodes.label: Load SAE
nodes.title: Load Sparse Autoencoder (SAE)
nodes.description: Loads a specific Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) for a given layer, which is used to extract and manipulate sparse representations.

nodes.label: Collect Latent Representations
nodes.title: Collect Latent Representations
nodes.description: Gathers latent representations from the language model for a set of input pairs, which are then used for F-statistic computation and optimization.

nodes.label: Optimize Steering Vector
nodes.title: Optimize Sparse Steering Vector
nodes.description: Performs the core optimization of the sparse steering vector based on collected latents, SAE decoder weights, and statistical measures.

nodes.label: Judge Generated Text
nodes.title: Judge Generated Text
nodes.description: Evaluates the quality of generated text against a predefined rubric and system prompt, returning a score.

nodes.label: Persona Trait Artifact
nodes.title: Persona Trait Artifact
nodes.description: Represents a structured definition of a persona trait, including its rubric and evaluation questions.

groups.label: Optimization Process
groups.title: SAE SSV Optimization Process
groups.description: Handles the core logic for optimizing Sparse Steering Vectors (SSV) based on SAE features and evaluating their impact.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: External System Dependencies
groups.description: Components and modules that this script relies on for its operations, such as model loading and judging services.
